paper.title: EXP-Bench: Can AI Conduct AI Research Experiments?

subset.rule: 461 题里不需要 GPU 的两篇论文：causal-learn（10 题）和 Smooth ECE（3 题），共 13 题（Issue #162）。阶段三的训练题和留出题由 #157 选。

sections:
## 共同的问题

| 编号 | 问题 | 证据 | 影响 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C1 | 判官看不到被测系统拿到的材料，也看不到系统自己的代码和产出 | PaperWritingBench 的 SxS 只读两篇论文（官方 `sxs_paper_quality.py`、`sxs_lit_review_quality.py`）；PaperWrite-Bench 的幻觉检查只拿原论文 LaTeX 对照（`evaluate_per_section.py` 的 pass 1）；ResearchClawBench 的判官只读报告、checklist 和图（`evaluation/score.py`） | 系统自己补出的方法细节、记错方法的数字、没有代码算过的数字都发现不了，有时还被当作优点加分（P1） | 新增 `faithfulness-judge`：逐条核对文档对自身工作的陈述与材料（和评测侧的参照）是否一致。验证见 P1、W3、R1 |
| C2 | 判官模型被替换，且去掉了采样参数 | Gemini `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` 由 Antigravity 以 `gemini-4-argon-high` 服务；GPT 判官（`gpt-4o`、`gpt-5`、`gpt-5.1`、`gpt-5.4`）由 codex-api 以 `gpt-5.6-sol`、effort medium 服务；`temperature`、`top_p` 被去掉（`codex_api.toml`） | 判官的宽严和波动可能与官方不同 | 每条分数记录实际服务的模型。替代判官有锚点：PaperWritingBench 原论文对其逐字节副本的 SxS 8 次全平（#42 调查）；ScienceAgentBench 图像判官对全部图像题做了 gold、他题 gold、空白三种锚点（S5）；ResearchClawBench 同一报告重复打分（R5） |
| C3 | 一次打分会波动 | ResearchClawBench 同一份报告五次打分在 23.7 和 29.3 之间（R5）；PaperWrite-Bench 同一份论文（运行 R2）重新打分，rubric 3.56 变 3.61、重大幻觉 1 条变 4 条、claim 241 条变 227 条（本 Issue）；PaperWritingBench 同一篇论文（运行 `…-20261028T002600Z`）的文献综述 #42 打 58 / 57（Gemini / GPT），本 Issue 重新打分 51 / 52；SxS 的胜负两次相同 | 单题、单次的差几分不说明问题 | ResearchClawBench 每次打分另打 2 次，报告均值、标准差和极差（`project_checks.repeats`）；其余两项单次打分要 20 次以上调用，只在汇总上比较 |
| C4 | 离线题不是完全断网：屏蔽放行 Python 包索引 | PaperWrite-Bench 的官方写作 agent 没有网络工具，ASI-Bench 榜单页写“没有外部工具访问”，PhysClosureBench 的 `network_access` 是 `disabled`；本项目这三个 benchmark 的题目以 `offline` 屏蔽运行，另放行 `pypi.org/simple/` 和 `files.pythonhosted.org/packages/` 的 `GET`/`HEAD`（设置 `shield.package_index`，每次运行的 `setup.network` 写 `package_index: allowed`，#105） | 被测系统能 pip 装包，官方 agent 不能；包索引不含题目答案，也不含论文内容，其他站点（文献、论文、代码托管、搜索）照旧 403，屏蔽表（原论文、仓库）先于放行生效 | 记入每次运行的记录和看板；不改官方评分；读离线题的结果时按此条理解联网条件 |

## EXP-Bench（`expbench-judge`）

| 编号 | 问题 | 证据 | 影响 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| E1 | 监控判官读不到的运行，官方的处理会把设计、结论、实现全部记 0 | 官方 `query_normal`：监控判官的答案里任一键为 True，或解析失败（`Error parsing response`），三项分数都记 0；它读的是 OpenHands 的日志。本项目 coding-agent 给的是 Claude Code 的流式转录，ResearchWorld 运行没有逐步日志，只有 `agent.log` | 监控判官读的材料和官方不同；ResearchWorld 的运行几乎看不到过程，判官既可能漏报（没有证据）也可能因日志空白被判成违规 | 照官方：解析失败算违规；每条分数的 `monitor` 记三项判断，`project_checks.judge_answers_parsed` 记是否解析成功；该影响未测量 |
| E2 | 判官被替换，调用方式也变了 | 官方 o3-mini（Azure），请求带 `response_format: json_object`；这里由 codex-api 服务的 `gpt-5.6-sol`（effort medium）。codex-api 对 `response_format` 回空内容（TruthInsightBench 一节引用的实测，#93），所以不请求该格式、从文本里取 JSON，最多重试 3 次（官方 `query_plain` 同样重试 3 次） | 判官的宽严和波动可能与官方不同 | 每条分数的 `judge` 记实际服务的模型和用量；`project_checks.judge_answers_parsed` 记各判官的答案是否解析成功 |
| E3 | 设计分和实现分是判官数出来的百分比，一次打分 | 设计判官“数 `design_output` 里有多少项对上 `design_ground_truth`”，实现判官“逐条看补丁满足了多少条 requirements”，都返回整数百分比；没有重复打分 | 单题分数噪声大（同一份答案换一次可能差十几分），“全部正确”几乎不会出现 | 照官方；比较系统看多题汇总，不对单题下结论 |
| E4 | 补丁很长时判官看到的是截断的 | 官方把过长的补丁拆成多次调用（最多 15 段）；这里一次调用，补丁最多 40 万字符，超出的部分截掉（`project_checks.patch.cut_for_the_judge`） | 大补丁（例如提交了大数据文件的运行）的后半部分判官看不到 | 记录是否截断；补丁里的二进制和 `__pycache__` 不进补丁 |
| E5 | 执行检查在可联网的容器里跑，且只看退出码 | 官方 `execute_setup`：新容器、`--network=host`、`cd /workspace && bash reproduce_exp_bench.sh`，1 小时超时，退出码 0 即成功；这里同样跑在默认网络的新容器里（评分是本项目的评测系统，不受联网屏蔽约束） | 脚本可以靠联网下载数据或装包成功，而运行里的 agent 是离线的；成功只说明脚本退出码为 0，不说明它复现了结论 | 照官方；`execution.json` 记退出码和输出末尾 |
| E6 | 污染高 | 两篇论文是 2023–2024 年的，结论和代码早已公开；README 里的结果就是答案 | 模型可能凭记忆答出结论，而没有做实验 | 遮住 README 和任务文件、屏蔽论文、仓库、文档站和 PyPI 上的同名包；监控判官查“伪造/硬编码数据”；但训练时见过的内容无法排除 |

判官被替换（E2）属于共同问题 C2；没有重复打分（C3）。

## Shared problems

| id | problem | evidence | impact | handling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C1 | The judges see neither the material the system was given nor the system's own code and outputs | PaperWritingBench's SxS reads two papers only (official `sxs_paper_quality.py`, `sxs_lit_review_quality.py`); PaperWrite-Bench's hallucination check compares with the original LaTeX only (pass 1 of `evaluate_per_section.py`); ResearchClawBench's judge reads the report, the checklist and images only (`evaluation/score.py`) | Method details the system made up, numbers credited to the wrong method and numbers no code computed go unnoticed, and are sometimes rewarded (P1) | New `faithfulness-judge`: every statement the document makes about its own work is checked against the materials (and an evaluator-side reference). Validation in P1, W3, R1 |
| C2 | The judge models are replaced, with sampling parameters removed | Gemini `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` is served by Antigravity as `gemini-4-argon-high`; the GPT judges (`gpt-4o`, `gpt-5`, `gpt-5.1`, `gpt-5.4`) are served by codex-api as `gpt-5.6-sol`, effort medium; `temperature` and `top_p` are removed (`codex_api.toml`) | A judge's strictness and spread may differ from the official one | Every score records the served model. The substitutes have anchors: PaperWritingBench's SxS of the original against a byte-identical copy of itself gave 8 ties in 8 (the #42 investigation); ScienceAgentBench's figure judge was run with gold, other-task gold and blank predictions on every figure task (S5); ResearchClawBench scores the same report again (R5) |
| C3 | One scoring varies | ResearchClawBench: five scorings of the same report lie between 23.7 and 29.3 (R5); PaperWrite-Bench: the same paper (run R2) scored again moved the rubric from 3.56 to 3.61, major hallucinations from 1 to 4 and claims from 241 to 227 (this Issue); PaperWritingBench: the same paper (run `…-20261028T002600Z`) got literature-review scores of 58 / 57 (Gemini / GPT) in #42 and 51 / 52 when scored again in this Issue; the SxS outcomes were the same both times | A difference of a few points on one item and one scoring means nothing | ResearchClawBench scores every report 2 more times and reports mean, standard deviation and range (`project_checks.repeats`); the other two need 20+ calls per scoring and are compared over many items only |
| C4 | Offline items are not fully cut off: the shield lets the Python package index through | PaperWrite-Bench's official writing agent has no network tools, the ASI-Bench leaderboard page says "no external tool access", PhysClosureBench's `network_access` is `disabled`; here the items of these three benchmarks run with the `offline` shield and additionally let through `GET`/`HEAD` on `pypi.org/simple/` and `files.pythonhosted.org/packages/` (setting `shield.package_index`; every run's `setup.network` states `package_index: allowed`, #105) | The systems under test can install packages with pip and the official agents cannot; the package index holds neither the item's answer nor the paper's content, every other site (literature, papers, code hosting, search) is still 403, and the list rules (original paper, repositories) win over the exception | Recorded in every run's record and on the dashboard; the official scoring is unchanged; read an offline item's result with this network condition in mind |

## EXP-Bench (`expbench-judge`)

| ID | Problem | Evidence | Effect | Handling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| E1 | When the monitor judge cannot read the run, the official handling zeroes design, conclusion and setup | Official `query_normal`: if any key of the monitor judge's answer is True, or the answer does not parse (`Error parsing response`), all three scores are 0; it reads an OpenHands log. Here the coding-agent supplies Claude Code's stream transcript, and a ResearchWorld run has no step-by-step log, only `agent.log` | The monitor reads other material than officially; a ResearchWorld run shows almost nothing of its process, so the judge may miss a violation (no evidence) or flag one because the log is empty | As official: an unparsable answer counts as a violation; each score's `monitor` records the three verdicts and `project_checks.judge_answers_parsed` whether they parsed; the effect is not measured |
| E2 | The judge is replaced, and the call changes | Officially o3-mini (Azure) with `response_format: json_object`; here `gpt-5.6-sol` served by codex-api (effort medium). codex-api answers `response_format` with empty content (measured in #93, cited in the TruthInsightBench section), so the format is not requested and the JSON is read out of the text, with up to 3 tries (upstream `query_plain` also retries 3 times) | The strictness and variance of the judge may differ from the official one | Each score's `judge` records the served model and usage; `project_checks.judge_answers_parsed` records whether each judge's answer parsed |
| E3 | The design and setup scores are percentages the judge counts, from one judgement | The design judge "counts how many items of `design_output` match `design_ground_truth`", the setup judge goes through the requirements one by one against the patch; both return an integer percentage; there is no repeat | A task's scores are noisy (the same answer may differ by ten points or more between two judgements), and "all correct" almost never occurs | As official; compare systems on the aggregate over many tasks, not on one task |
| E4 | A very long patch reaches the judge cut | Officially a long patch is split over several calls (at most 15 parts); here one call, the patch cut at 400,000 characters (`project_checks.patch.cut_for_the_judge`) | The later part of a large patch (e.g. a run that committed large data files) is not seen by the judge | The cut is recorded; binaries and `__pycache__` are not in the patch |
| E5 | The execution check runs in a container with network access and looks at the exit code only | Official `execute_setup`: a fresh container, `--network=host`, `cd /workspace && bash reproduce_exp_bench.sh`, 1 hour limit, exit code 0 is a success; here the same in a fresh container on the default network (scoring is this project's evaluator and is not under the network shield) | The script can succeed by downloading data or packages while the agent in the run was offline; success says only that the exit code is 0, not that it reproduced the conclusion | As official; `execution.json` records the exit code and the end of the output |
| E6 | High contamination | The two papers are from 2023-2024, their conclusions and code have long been public; the README results are the answers | A model may state the conclusion from memory without running the experiment | The README and the task files are masked and the paper, the repository, the documentation site and the same-name PyPI packages are shielded; the monitor judge looks for faked or hard-coded data; what the model saw in training cannot be excluded |

The replaced judge (E2) is common problem C2; scores are not repeated (C3).

  code:
    spdx: Apache-2.0
    source: Curie 仓库 LICENSE
  data:
    spdx: CC-BY-4.0
    redistribution: "数据集卡标 CC-BY-4.0。任务文字由 LLM 从论文和代码生成，论文本身和它们的代码仓库的权利归各自作者。"
    source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Just-Curieous/EXP-Bench 的 README（2026-11-01）
  code_repositories:
    - {repo: py-why/causal-learn, spdx: MIT, source: 仓库 LICENSE}
    - {repo: apple/ml-calibration, spdx: "Apple Inc. 软件许可（非 OSI 许可证）", source: 仓库 LICENSE（允许在遵守条款的前提下使用和修改，不是开源许可证；本项目只把它克隆下来做研究评测，不再分发）}

run:
  harness: Curie 的 EXP-Bench 评估（evaluation/eval.py 生成、evaluation/judge.py 判分）；官方 agent 是 OpenHands 和 Inspect agent，在干净容器里工作
  stages:
    - stage: 1_generation
      input: "论文仓库（遮住 README 和任务的 masked_source 文件），提示 = evaluation/prompts/eval_gen_prompt.txt 填上问题、方法、agent_instructions"
      output: "JSON {design, conclusion} 加一个能从头复现实验的脚本 reproduce_exp_bench.sh；代码改动取 git diff"
      source: evaluation/eval.py
    - stage: 2_judging
      method: "监控判官读 agent 日志，查有没有读论文、做 Git 操作、用伪造/硬编码数据；设计判官对照 design_complexity 给设计分（0–100），结论判官对照 expected_outcome 判对错；实现（setup）判官对照 requirements 和遮住的源文件读补丁给实现分（0–100）；执行检查在新容器里运行 reproduce_exp_bench.sh（1 小时超时），退出码为 0 即成功。监控判官查出违规则设计、结论、实现全部记 0。"
      judge: "论文用 o3-mini（Azure）"
      source: evaluation/judge.py ; evaluation/prompts/eval_judge*.txt
  commands:
    install: "git clone https://github.com/Just-Curieous/Curie && git checkout db1b1f56159b591515f77e03c55bf473d5c1c201 && cd benchmark/exp_bench && docker build -t exp-bench-image -f ExpDockerfile_default ."
    generate: "python evaluation/parallel_eval.py"
    judge: "python evaluation/parallel_eval.py --task_config=evaluation/configs/parallel_eval_judge_config_template.json"
  official_time_limits: "每题 max_duration_per_task_in_hours（配置里设；README 提醒单个 LLM+Agent 组合可能要几天）；执行检查 1 小时。"
  gpu: "13 题不需要（causal-learn 和 Smooth ECE 两篇）"
  external_services: "判官：OpenAI 兼容端点（本项目经 codex-api）；官方 agent 需要各家模型 API"

subset:
  rule: "461 题里不需要 GPU 的两篇论文：causal-learn（10 题）和 Smooth ECE（3 题），共 13 题（Issue #162）。阶段三的训练题和留出题由 #157 选。"
  count_verified: 13
  formal_batch:
    rule: "没有正式批次：本 benchmark 是阶段三做实验岗位的训练环境（#141、#157），题目由 #157 选定。"
  contamination: "高：两篇论文是 2023–2024 年的，结论和代码早已公开，README 里的结果就是答案；本项目遮住 README 和任务文件，屏蔽表挡论文、仓库、文档站和 PyPI 上这两个包（避免 pip 下载到被遮住的源码），但模型可能在训练时见过。"
  budget:
    per_task_cap: "官方由配置给；本项目不设自己的上限，只受框架统一的一周上限约束。"
    resources: "CPU 即可；镜像约 1–2 GB，/workspace 77 MB（causal-learn）或 1.4 MB（Smooth ECE）"

task_interface:
  reference: "expbench/<causal-learn|smooth-ece>-<任务序号>，见 items"
  renderer: src/researchworld_eval/benchmarks/expbench.py
  prompt: "evaluation/prompts/eval_gen_prompt.txt 原文，填上任务的 question、method、agent_instructions；additional_info 是“仓库在 /workspace，离线数据集在 /data/…”；答案 JSON 写到 /workspace/exp_bench_answer.json，脚本写到 /workspace/reproduce_exp_bench.sh"
  candidate: "任务环境镜像（rwe-bench-exp-env:<任务>-<哈希>）：固定 Python 基础镜像、固定版本的依赖、遮住后的论文仓库在 /workspace（只有一个提交的新 Git 仓库）、离线数据集在 /data"
  limits: {}   # 官方由配置给；不设上限
  offline: true   # 官方 agent 容器可联网；本项目只放行包索引，数据集随镜像
  remaining_differences: "官方克隆论文仓库的 HEAD 并保留历史，这里固定提交、不带历史；原本运行时下载的数据集改为随镜像离线提供（提示里写明）；task 6（DirectLiNGAM）的 masked_source 路径在仓库里是 direct_lingam.py，官方会因找不到文件跳过这题，这里按文件名忽略大小写和下划线匹配遮住它；评分的判官由 o3-mini 换成 codex-api 的 GPT；监控判官读的是本项目的 agent 转录而不是 OpenHands 日志。"
  never_candidate: [expected_outcome, design_complexity, requirements, masked_source 的内容, 数据集的 verification/, Curie 仓库的 outputs/logs]

evaluator.text:
# EXP-Bench

[中文](README.md) | English

The machine-readable facts are in [`MANIFEST.yaml`](MANIFEST.yaml); this page says what a reader needs and points to where each fact sits in the manifest.

## What it is

EXP-Bench measures whether an AI agent can carry out a complete research experiment: given a research question, a description of the method and the paper's repository with some files masked, the agent designs the experiment, implements it, runs it and concludes. There are 461 tasks from 51 AI papers.
This project uses only the **13 tasks that need no GPU**, from two papers: causal-learn (NeurIPS 2024, JMLR, 10 tasks) and Smooth ECE (ICLR 2024, 3 tasks) (source: MANIFEST.yaml `source.cpu_papers`).

- Paper: arXiv 2505.24785.
- Evaluation code and tasks: `benchmark/exp_bench` of `Just-Curieous/Curie`, pinned commit `db1b1f56159b591515f77e03c55bf473d5c1c201` (Apache-2.0); the task JSON files are in its `outputs/logs/<conference>/<paper id>/`.
- Dataset: HF `Just-Curieous/EXP-Bench`, pinned revision `0c4f4e47cc9ceb9a67d5fce7224ed6c7699d432a` (CC-BY-4.0); the question texts of the 13 tasks were checked one by one against Curie's JSON.
- The two paper repositories: `py-why/causal-learn` (MIT) pinned at `9689c1b`, `apple/ml-calibration` (Apple's software licence, not an OSI licence) pinned at `0b50da4` — each the last commit before the paper's arXiv date (2025-05-31).
  The official harness clones the then-current HEAD, unpinned; the base commits in the dataset's `verification/` are from a 2026 reproduction check and are not used (source: MANIFEST.yaml `source.commit_choice`).
- Data entries in this repository: assets `expbench-curie`, `expbench-hf`, `expbench-repo-causal-learn`, `expbench-repo-ml-calibration` and `expbench-data` (the few datasets the original code downloads at run time, fetched once and provided offline in the image), read through the links under `assets/` (source: `assets/MANIFEST.yaml`).

## Licence

Curie evaluation code Apache-2.0; dataset CC-BY-4.0; causal-learn MIT; **ml-calibration is under Apple's own software licence** (use and modification allowed under its terms; not an open-source licence); the papers' rights stay with their authors; the offline datasets have their own sources and their licences were not checked one by one.
This project only clones or downloads them for research evaluation and never commits or redistributes them (source: MANIFEST.yaml `license`).

## Items and batches

The 13 tasks are the manifest's `items`: `expbench/causal-learn-0` to `-9` and `expbench/smooth-ece-0` to `-2` (the suffix is the task index in the paper). `uv run researchworld_eval tasks --benchmark expbench` lists them.

**There is no formal batch**: it is a training environment of the phase 3 experiment role (items chosen in #157). `src/tasks/batches/expbench.yaml` is the whole set and is not in `plan.batches`.
**Contamination is high**: the two papers are from 2023-2024, their conclusions and code have long been public, and the README results are the answers. This project masks the README and the task files and shields the paper, the repositories, the documentation site and the same-name PyPI packages, but what a model saw in training cannot be excluded (JUDGES E6).

## How it runs and is scored

- Official entry: `evaluation/eval.py` clones the paper repository in a fresh container, masks the README and the task's `masked_source` files, fills the prompt and lets OpenHands or the Inspect agent work; the agent returns a JSON (`design`, `conclusion`) and a script that reproduces the experiment.
  `evaluation/judge.py` judges: a monitor judge reads the agent log (paper read, Git operations, faked data), a design judge (0-100), a conclusion judge (correct/incorrect), a setup judge (reads the patch, 0-100), then an execution check runs the script in a fresh container (1 hour, exit code 0 is a success). The official judge is o3-mini.
- This project's judge is the GPT served by codex-api (`gpt-5.6-sol`); the execution check is done as officially; each score records the served model and usage.

## One item: what the system gets and how it is scored

Written `expbench/<task>`; coding-agent and ResearchWorld can run it:

```bash
uv run researchworld_eval run coding-agent expbench/causal-learn-5 --condition CC-sonnet --purpose smoke
uv run researchworld_eval providers codex-api start
uv run researchworld_eval score expbench-judge <run-id> --credential codex=codex
```

- **Given (candidate side, rendered by `researchworld_eval.benchmarks.expbench`)**: the task image (`rwe-bench-exp-env:<task>-<hash>`, built here: a pinned Python base image, pinned dependency versions, the masked paper repository at `/workspace`, the offline datasets at `/data`);
  the prompt is the official `eval_gen_prompt.txt` filled with the task's `question`, `method` and `agent_instructions`, with the additional info naming the repository and the offline datasets; the answer goes to `/workspace/exp_bench_answer.json` and the script to `/workspace/reproduce_exp_bench.sh`.
  `/workspace` is a fresh Git repository with one commit (`git diff` shows only the agent's own changes, and no history can reveal the masked files).
- **Not given**: `expected_outcome`, `design_complexity`, `requirements`, the contents of the masked files, the dataset's `verification/`, the task JSON files of the Curie repository.
- **Deliverable**: `/workspace` (the agent's code changes, the answer JSON and the script); the evaluator derives the patch from it.
- **Time limit**: officially set by the configuration; this project sets none of its own and only the framework-wide one-week cap applies.
- **Network shield**: an offline item, only the package index is allowed (common problem C4); the datasets the papers use are in the image. The shield ([`shield.yaml`](shield.yaml)) blocks the dataset, the Curie and verification repositories, the two original papers' pages, the two paper repositories, causal-learn's documentation site,
  and the PyPI packages `causal-learn` and `relplot` (otherwise `pip download` would hand over the masked sources); the date cap is the original paper's arXiv v1 submission date.
- **Scoring**: the evaluator [`expbench-judge`](../../../evaluators/expbench_judge/README.en.md), which also records the design score, the setup score, whether the conclusion is correct, whether the execution succeeded and their mean `metrics.mean` (this project's summary; officially the four are reported separately).

### Differences from the official protocol

- The paper repository is pinned and has no history; the datasets the original code downloads only at run time are provided offline in the image (the prompt says so); the dependencies are pinned.
- The masked path `lingam/DirectLiNGAM.py` of `causal-learn-6` is `direct_lingam.py` in the repository: the official harness skips that task because the file is not found; here it is masked by file name up to case and underscores.
- The monitor judge reads this project's agent transcript (a ResearchWorld run has only `agent.log`), not an OpenHands log; the judge is the GPT of codex-api; a very long patch is cut (JUDGES E1-E5).

## Published reference scores

The paper reports the design, implementation, conclusion and execution correctness of agent+LLM combinations over the 461 tasks, with a low share of fully correct tasks; there is no separate total for these 13 tasks and no per-task public score, so nothing is registered as a per-task baseline (source: MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores`).

## Smoke

Both smoke runs use `causal-learn-5` (the ANM causal-direction experiment), `--purpose smoke`, judge `--credential codex=codex` (gpt-5.6-sol).

| Condition | Run | Wall clock | Equivalent cost | Score (design / implementation / conclusion / execution, mean) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CC-sonnet (Claude Code + claude-sonnet-5-5 / high, `--hours 1`) | `coding-agent-expbench--causal-learn-5-20261101T215147Z` | 686 s | $0.130 | 1 / 1 / 1 / 1, mean 1.0 |
| RW-sonnet (ResearchWorld HuTian 4.2.0 + claude-sonnet-5-5 / high, `--hours 2`) | `researchworld-expbench--causal-learn-5-20261101T221623Z` | 1858 s | $2.069 | 1 / 1 / 1 / 1, mean 1.0 |

Execution check: a world (RW) delivers only the files it wrote, not the whole repository, so the execution check runs the delivered files over the masked original repository; files the container wrote as root are chowned back to the current user before removal; a failure shows the tails of both stdout and stderr.

Shield audit: both runs are tier `hit_and_used` (CC: 0 hits, 10 uses; RW: 0 hits, 2 uses); the `used` matches are all links to itself inside the paper repository's own files (the repository address in `setup.py`, PyPI links in the docs), not content fetched from the web.

# EXP-Bench

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

机器可读的事实在 [`MANIFEST.yaml`](MANIFEST.yaml)；本文只说明读者需要知道的内容，并指出每条事实在 manifest 里的位置。

## 是什么

EXP-Bench 衡量 AI agent 能不能完成一个完整的研究实验：给研究问题、方法描述和遮住了部分文件的论文仓库，agent 要设计实验、实现、运行，并给出结论。共 461 题，来自 51 篇 AI 论文。
本项目只接**不需要 GPU 的 13 题**，来自两篇论文：causal-learn（NeurIPS 2024，JMLR，10 题）和 Smooth ECE（ICLR 2024，3 题）（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `source.cpu_papers`）。

- 论文：arXiv 2505.24785。
- 评估代码和任务：`Just-Curieous/Curie` 的 `benchmark/exp_bench`，固定 commit `db1b1f56159b591515f77e03c55bf473d5c1c201`（Apache-2.0）；任务的 JSON 在它的 `outputs/logs/<会议>/<论文号>/`。
- 数据集：HF `Just-Curieous/EXP-Bench`，固定 revision `0c4f4e47cc9ceb9a67d5fce7224ed6c7699d432a`（CC-BY-4.0）；13 题的问题文字与 Curie 的 JSON 逐题核对一致。
- 两个论文仓库：`py-why/causal-learn`（MIT）固定在 `9689c1b`，`apple/ml-calibration`（Apple 软件许可，非 OSI 许可证）固定在 `0b50da4`——都是论文 arXiv 日期（2025-05-31）之前的最后一个提交。
  官方 harness 克隆的是当时的 HEAD，没有固定；数据集 `verification/` 里的 base commit 是 2026 年复现验证用的，不用（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `source.commit_choice`）。
- 本仓库的数据入口：资产 `expbench-curie`、`expbench-hf`、`expbench-repo-causal-learn`、`expbench-repo-ml-calibration` 和 `expbench-data`（任务原代码运行时才下载的几个数据集，下载一次、随镜像离线提供），经 `assets/` 链接读取（来源：`assets/MANIFEST.yaml`）。

## 许可

Curie 评估代码 Apache-2.0；数据集 CC-BY-4.0；causal-learn MIT；**ml-calibration 是 Apple 自己的软件许可**（允许在遵守条款的前提下使用和修改，不是开源许可证）；论文本身的权利归作者；离线数据集各有来源，没有逐个核对许可。
本项目只把它们克隆或下载下来做研究评测，不提交、不再分发（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `license`）。

## 题目和批次

13 题的名单是 manifest 的 `items`：`expbench/causal-learn-0` 到 `-9`、`expbench/smooth-ece-0` 到 `-2`（后缀是论文里的任务序号）。`uv run researchworld_eval tasks --benchmark expbench` 列出它们。

**没有正式批次**：它是阶段三做实验岗位的训练环境（选题见 #157）；`src/tasks/batches/expbench.yaml` 是全集，不在 `plan.batches` 里。
**污染高**：两篇论文是 2023–2024 年的，结论和代码早已公开，README 里的结果就是答案。本项目遮住 README 和任务文件，屏蔽论文、仓库、文档站和 PyPI 上的同名包，但模型训练时见过的内容无法排除（JUDGES.md E6）。

## 怎么运行和评分

- 官方入口：`evaluation/eval.py` 在新容器里克隆论文仓库、遮住 README 和任务的 `masked_source` 文件、填提示，让 OpenHands 或 Inspect agent 工作；agent 交出 JSON（`design`、`conclusion`）和一个能复现实验的脚本。
  `evaluation/judge.py` 评判：监控判官读 agent 日志（有没有读论文、做 Git 操作、用伪造数据）、设计判官（0–100）、结论判官（对/错）、实现判官（读补丁，0–100），再在新容器里运行脚本做执行检查（1 小时，退出码 0 为成功）。官方判官是 o3-mini。
- 本项目的判官由 codex-api 服务的 GPT 担任（`gpt-5.6-sol`），执行检查照官方做；分数记实际服务的模型和用量。

## 一道题：交给系统什么、怎么评分

写作 `expbench/<任务>`，coding-agent 和 ResearchWorld 都可以运行：

```bash
uv run researchworld_eval run coding-agent expbench/causal-learn-5 --condition CC-sonnet --purpose smoke
uv run researchworld_eval providers codex-api start
uv run researchworld_eval score expbench-judge <run-id> --credential codex=codex
```

- **给系统的（候选侧，`researchworld_eval.benchmarks.expbench` 渲染）**：任务镜像（`rwe-bench-exp-env:<任务>-<哈希>`，本机构建：固定的 Python 基础镜像、固定版本的依赖、遮住后的论文仓库在 `/workspace`、离线数据集在 `/data`）；
  提示是官方 `eval_gen_prompt.txt` 填上该题的 `question`、`method`、`agent_instructions`，附加信息写明仓库位置和离线数据集；答案写到 `/workspace/exp_bench_answer.json`，脚本写到 `/workspace/reproduce_exp_bench.sh`。
  `/workspace` 是只有一个提交的新 Git 仓库（`git diff` 只显示 agent 自己的改动，没有历史可以翻出被遮住的文件）。
- **不给的**：`expected_outcome`、`design_complexity`、`requirements`、被遮住的文件内容、数据集的 `verification/`、Curie 仓库的任务 JSON。
- **交付物**：`/workspace`（agent 的代码改动、答案 JSON 和脚本）；评测系统从它推出补丁。
- **时间上限**：官方由配置给，本项目不设自己的上限，只受一周统一上限约束。
- **联网屏蔽**：离线题，只放行包索引（共同问题 C4）；论文要用的数据集随镜像。屏蔽表（[`shield.yaml`](shield.yaml)）挡数据集、Curie 仓库和验证仓库、两篇原论文的页面、两个论文仓库、causal-learn 的文档站，
  以及 PyPI 上的 `causal-learn` 和 `relplot`（否则 `pip download` 会直接拿到被遮住的源码）；日期上限取原论文 arXiv v1 的提交日。
- **评分**：评测系统 [`expbench-judge`](../../../evaluators/expbench_judge/README.md)，另记设计分、实现分、结论对错、执行成功和四项均值 `metrics.mean`（本项目的汇总，官方分别报告）。

### 与官方协议的差异

- 论文仓库固定提交且不带历史；任务原代码运行时才下载的数据集随镜像离线提供（提示里写明）；依赖固定版本。
- `causal-learn-6` 的遮住路径 `lingam/DirectLiNGAM.py` 在仓库里叫 `direct_lingam.py`：官方会因找不到文件而跳过这题，这里按文件名忽略大小写和下划线匹配遮住它。
- 监控判官读本项目的 agent 转录（ResearchWorld 的运行只有 `agent.log`），不是 OpenHands 日志；判官换成 codex-api 的 GPT；补丁过长时截断（JUDGES.md E1–E5）。

## 公开对照分数

论文报告 461 题上各 agent+LLM 组合的设计、实现、结论和执行正确率，全部正确的比例很低；没有这 13 题的单独汇总，本项目没有逐题公开分数，不登记为逐题 baseline（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores`）。

## 冒烟

两次冒烟都用 `causal-learn-5`（ANM 因果方向实验），`--purpose smoke`，判官 `--credential codex=codex`（gpt-5.6-sol）。

| 条件 | 运行 | 墙钟 | 等价费用 | 分数（设计 / 实现 / 结论 / 执行，均值） |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CC-sonnet（Claude Code + claude-sonnet-5-5 / high，`--hours 1`） | `coding-agent-expbench--causal-learn-5-20261101T215147Z` | 686 s | $0.130 | 1 / 1 / 1 / 1，均值 1.0 |
| RW-sonnet（ResearchWorld HuTian 4.2.0 + claude-sonnet-5-5 / high，`--hours 2`） | `researchworld-expbench--causal-learn-5-20261101T221623Z` | 1858 s | $2.069 | 1 / 1 / 1 / 1，均值 1.0 |

执行检查：世界（RW）只交付它写过的文件而不是整个仓库，所以执行检查在遮住后的原仓库上覆盖交付文件再运行；容器以 root 写出的文件在删除前先 chown 回当前用户；失败时同时给出 stdout 和 stderr 的尾部。

安全审计：两次的审计层级都是 `hit_and_used`（CC 命中 0、使用 10；RW 命中 0、使用 2）；使用的命中全部是论文仓库自带文件里指向它自己的链接（如 `setup.py` 的仓库地址、文档里的 PyPI 链接），不是从网上取得的内容。

conditions.name: RW-sol
conditions.description: ResearchWorld：E2E 任务用全部岗位（HuTian v4.9 起 8 个，v4.8.2 及更早 9 个）；benchmark 题目按 HuTian 官方 benchmark 设置选岗位；所有岗位同一模型（Codex）
conditions.description_en: ResearchWorld: all roles for E2E tasks (8 since HuTian v4.9, 9 on v4.8.2 and earlier); benchmark items take the roles of HuTian's own benchmark settings; the same model (Codex) in every role
conditions.notes: 所有岗位用 HuTian 现有的 Codex worker，gpt-6.1-sol、effort high，和 CX-sol 同模型同档 effort，成对比较“RW 用 Codex 能不能超过单个 Codex agent”。Codex 岗位直接用项目自己的 Codex 登录（HuTian 的 HT_CODEX_AUTH_FILE，不经 codex-api：HuTian 的强制代理只放行官方端点）：默认 `codex-jack` 账号的 `codex-jack-rw`（和经 codex-api 用 `codex-jack` 的条件共用额度），可按运行改选 `codex-jacques-rw`（和判官共用额度）；判官用 `codex-jacques`。和经 codex-api 用 `codex-jack` 的 CX-sol、AS-sol、EVO-sol 可以同时运行，只共用账号的用量额度（preflight 在同一批次里两者并存时打印 note）；RW-sol 和 RW-mixed 的 Codex 岗位读同一个登录文件，由 HuTian 自己的锁串行刷新。RW-astra 和混合版暂不加。
conditions.notes_en: Every role uses HuTian's existing Codex worker, gpt-6.1-sol at effort high, the same model and effort as CX-sol for a paired comparison of whether RW with Codex can beat a single Codex agent. The Codex roles use the project's own Codex login directly (HuTian's HT_CODEX_AUTH_FILE, not through codex-api: HuTian's mandatory proxy admits only the official endpoints): by default `codex-jack-rw` of the `codex-jack` account (sharing the allowance with the conditions that use `codex-jack` through codex-api), or `codex-jacques-rw` when chosen per run (sharing the allowance with the judges); the judges use `codex-jacques`. RW-sol can run at the same time as CX-sol, AS-sol and EVO-sol, which use `codex-jack` through codex-api, and they only share the account's usage allowance (preflight prints a note when a batch holds both); RW-sol and the Codex roles of RW-mixed read the same login file, and HuTian's own lock serialises their refreshes. RW-astra and a mixed variant are not added for now.

preinstalled.en: node:22 bookworm base; Claude Code and Codex CLI (pinned), a TeX Live subset (ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS), python3 + uv, git, the shared controlled-search MCP server

notes.driver: no scaffold: one headless CLI invocation; it stops when the model stops (no /goal or loop)
notes.search: provider server-side search disabled; shared controlled search offered as MCP tools search_literature / search_web
notes.web_access: WebFetch and Bash network stay on, but only through the shield proxy: URL blocklist applies, OpenAlex/S2/Tavily API calls are date-bounded, arbitrary fetched pages are not date-bounded
notes.venue: chosen by the agent from the task text; detected from LaTeX at collect time
notes.wall_clock: enforced by the runner; the entrypoint turns its SIGTERM into SIGINT so the CLI can end cleanly

notes.permissions: --permission-mode bypassPermissions (container and shield are the boundary)
notes.extra_model_calls: WebFetch runs a secondary extraction model call inside Claude Code; counted in modelUsage
notes.telemetry: telemetry, error reporting and nonessential traffic disabled; this also stops feature-flag fetching

conditions.notes_en: The GPT-6.1 Sol column of phase 1. preinstalled.en: upstream's locked dependencies (uv sync --frozen) plus compat.patch; TeX Live (with fonts-extra and latexmk); a research Python environment for the agent in /opt/research

notes.agent: No external coding agent: EvoScientist runs its own in-process planner/research/code/debug/writing sub-agents (LangChain deepagents) on the one configured model. conditions.agent only selects the provider; Claude Code and Codex are not used.
notes.model: Main agent, sub-agents and EvoScientist's auxiliary calls (tool selector, memory workers, summariser, graders) all use the configured model; auxiliary_model and model_fallbacks are empty.
notes.effort: Upstream hard-wires effort=max and max_tokens=128000 for Anthropic models. compat.patch makes the effort come from EVOSCIENTIST_REASONING_EFFORT (= conditions.effort); max_tokens stays 128000 (a cap, not a cost driver). Adaptive thinking (display=summarized) is upstream and not switchable.
notes.paper: The core writes a Markdown report (final_report.md); the EvoSkills paper-writing skill gives a generic LaTeX `article` skeleton with no ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS style and no compile step. The image has TeX Live (latexmk, fonts-extra) but no venue style files; the task asks for an official template, so a venue-formatted PDF depends on the agent obtaining the style through the shield. No extra pipeline stage was added; absent items are listed in result.missing.
notes.tools: skill_manager (git clone of any repository as a skill) is not registered (compat.patch); the Tavily key is not set so tavily_search does not exist; LANGGRAPH_CLI_NO_ANALYTICS=1; EvoSkills is baked in at its pinned commit. The execute shell and the EvoSkills paper-navigator scripts reach the world only through the shield; S2_DATE_CUTOFF is not set (the shield bounds dates).
notes.server_side_search: Not reachable: EvoScientist binds no provider-side search tool to any model (its only tools are think_tool, tavily_search when TAVILY_API_KEY is set, MCP tools from mcp.yaml, deepagents built-ins and skills; EvoScientist/EvoScientist.py:671-672 and 754-755 at the pin; the one bind_tools call is the tool selector's own output schema, middleware/tool_selector.py:166). TAVILY_API_KEY is not passed and the image has no mcp.yaml, so no search tool exists. Anthropic/OpenAI hosts are only tunnelled by the shield, so a provider-side search would be invisible to the audit.
notes.credentials: The provider key is in the process environment and EvoScientist's execute shell inherits the environment (upstream has no switch); the key is therefore visible to the agent's shell. It is a run-scoped copy and is not logged by this adapter.
notes.memory: A fresh data dir per run (baked skills, empty memory). Memory workers, skill synthesis and the scheduler stay at upstream defaults, so their LLM calls count in the usage log.
notes.limits: async sub-agents off (README advice for scripted runs); recursion_limit=1000000; model retry wait in auto-mode 21600 s (time without progress counts as wall time); execute timeout 300 s per command. No token or cost budget exists.
